info.title: IDClawserver API
info.description: API for AI agent identities backed by RODiT tokens on NEAR, including facial token_id encoding.

BearerAuth.description: RODiT-issued JWT access token validated by @rodit/rodit-auth-be (RoditClient.authenticate), obtained via the RODiT login flow (e.g. /api/login). This is not an API key.

TokenId.description: Facial token_id encoding: 12 lowercase letters a-z (11 category indices + 1 checksum).

categories.description: Map from facial category name (e.g. skin_tones) to encoded value.

id.description: Identifier for the verification method fragment.

controller.description: Controller DID for the verification method.

@context.description: Ordered list of JSON-LD contexts used in the DID document.

alsoKnownAs.description: Alternate DID identifiers for the same subject.

controller.description: Controller account for the DID document.

verificationMethod.description: Verification methods available on the DID document.

service.description: Service endpoints advertised in the DID document.

requestId.description: Request correlation identifier returned by the API.

get.summary: API discovery endpoint with enrollment information
get.description: Returns API discovery information including enrollment URL, documentation links, and available endpoints grouped by access level.
Provides comprehensive enrollment information including pricing tiers, step-by-step enrollment process, and authentication flow details.
Returns the OpenAPI 3.0 specification for this API.
Redirects to the main OpenAPI specification.
Returns an interactive HTML documentation page using Swagger UI.

get.summary: Get a concatenation-ready timestamp+noncets fragment for HOLA handshake

200.description: Returns a noncets string (timestamp+hex composite) that can be concatenated without further processing into a HOLA handshake message, together with the underlying timestamp.

noncets.description: Preformatted fragment of the form :<ISO8601-timestamp>:<NONCETS-HEX>: suitable for HOLA handshake construction.

timestamp.description: Server ISO-8601 timestamp when the noncets was generated.

length.description: Number of random bytes used to generate the noncets_hex component.

algorithm.description: Algorithm used to generate the noncets_hex component.

500.description: Agent discovery failed due to upstream service errors.

get.summary: Get timestamp and nonce for AI agent login
get.description: Public endpoint for AI agents to obtain timestamps and random nonces needed to construct /api/login requests. AI agents often struggle with real-time data and random number generation; this endpoint provides pre-generated values.

200.description: Authentication parameters for constructing login requests.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in seconds (as expected by /api/login).

nonce_length.description: Length of the nonce in bytes (32).

algorithm.description: Algorithm used to generate the nonce.

purpose.description: Guidance on how to use these values.

429.description: Too Many Requests - rate limit exceeded (100 requests per minute).

get.summary: List RODiT token holders with facial descriptions
get.description: Returns a paginated list of all RODiT token holders with their facial descriptions decoded from token IDs. This is a public endpoint for agent discovery. For detailed identity info including DN and full metadata, use the protected /api/identity/token/{tokenId}/full endpoint.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of agents to return (default: 20, max: 100)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page

200.description: Paginated list of agents with facial descriptions

checksumValid.description: Whether the token ID checksum is valid

categories.description: Facial feature categories with their values

nextCursor.description: Cursor for fetching the next page, null if no more results

get.summary: Get authenticated agent's own DN and facial description
get.description: Returns the caller's own Distinguished Name (DN) and facial description based on their authenticated RODiT token. This endpoint is for self-identification only - it derives the caller's tokenId from the JWT sub field. For looking up other agents, use GET /api/identity/token/{tokenId}/full.

200.description: Authenticated agent's own DN and facial description.

dn.description: Parsed Distinguished Name information from token metadata.

metadata.description: Full token metadata including openapijson_url, not_after, not_before, max_requests, webhook_url, userselected_dn, and userselected_dn_info.

400.description: IdentityUnavailable when sub is missing or unparsable.

error.message: JWT payload is missing required sub field for identity derivation

404.description: IdentityNotFound when NEAR token does not exist.

post.summary: Verify a peer's hello using Ed25519 and a Morse-compatible canonical message

hello.description: HOLA handshake line exchanged between AI agents: HOLA:<tokenId>:<ISO8601-timestamp>:<noncets-hex>:API.IDENTYCLAW.COM:<base64url-ed25519-signature>:<checksum>. The Ed25519 signature is computed over HOLA:<tokenId>:<ISO8601-timestamp>:<noncets-hex>:API.IDENTYCLAW.COM: and the checksum is a single hex character computed from HOLA:<tokenId>:<ISO8601-timestamp>:<noncets-hex>:API.IDENTYCLAW.COM:<base64url-ed25519-signature>:. Note: noncets-hex is the hex component from the noncets endpoint, NOT a simple nonce. Maximum length: 512 characters.

maxAgeMs.description: Maximum allowed age in milliseconds for the hello. Defaults to 300000.

verified.description: True when all checks pass and the peer hello is accepted.

peerTokenId.description: token_id extracted from the peer hello.

checks.description: Detailed boolean flags indicating which verification stages passed.

tokenExists.description: True when the peer token exists on NEAR.

tokenActive.description: True when the token is considered active (not revoked/expired).

timestampFresh.description: True when the timestamp is within the accepted age window.

signatureValid.description: True when the Ed25519 signature matches the canonical message.

checksumValid.description: True when the checksum matches the canonical hello payload.

failureReasons.description: List of machine-readable codes describing why verification failed. Empty when verified is true.

signatureVerificationImplemented.description: Signals that signature verification is active for this server implementation.

400.description: InvalidRequest or InvalidPeerHello - malformed hello string, invalid format, or validation failure.

post.summary: RODiT client login to obtain a JWT access token

schema.description: Login payload as expected by the RODiT SDK (e.g. NEP-413 credentials).

200.description: Login successful; response body is produced by the RODiT SDK and includes a jwt_token.

post.summary: RODiT client logout to invalidate the current session

200.description: Logout successful; response body is produced by the RODiT SDK.

post.summary: Request minting of a client RODiT via SignPortal
post.description: Frontend calls this endpoint with tamperproofed values and a locally computed minting fee. The server validates permissions against its own permissioned_routes, recomputes the minting fee, and then delegates to SignPortal to mint a new client RODiT token.

tobesignedValues.description: Tamperproof payload describing the client RODiT to mint (includes permissioned_routes, max_requests, maxrq_window, not_after, serviceprovider_signature, etc.).

mintingfee.description: Total minting fee computed by the client; must match the server's own calculation or the request will be rejected.

201.description: Client RODiT minted successfully; response body is the SignPortal result including token_id and optional fee_signature_base64url.

400.description: Validation error such as missing fields, invalid permissioned_routes, minting fee mismatch, or bad date/limits.

500.description: Server or SignPortal error while attempting to mint the client token.

get.summary: List available MCP resources (including OpenAPI schema)
get.description: Returns a list of all available MCP resources including: OpenAPI schema, skills documentation, enrollment guide, troubleshooting guide, value proposition (why-identyclaw), policy documents, NEAR onboarding guide, and JSON-LD contexts. Use /api/mcp/resource/{uri} to retrieve specific resources.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific MCP resource by URI
get.description: Fetches a specific resource by its URI. Available resources include: openapi:swagger, config:default, skills:skills, readme:main, health:status, guide:api, guide:enrollment, guide:why-identyclaw, guide:troubleshooting, policy:terms, policy:privacy, policy:data-retention, policy:service-info, onboarding:near, jsonld:context, jsonld:contract-metadata.

get.summary: Return the OpenAPI schema used by this server

200.description: Schema wrapper containing the OpenAPI document and a requestId.

get.summary: Get current performance metrics for this IDClawserver instance

200.description: Aggregated request and session metrics, including request counts and active sessions.

get.summary: Get system resource metrics (CPU, memory, etc.)

200.description: Current system metrics as reported by the performance service.

post.description: Resets in-memory performance counters such as request counts and error counts. Caller must have appropriate admin permissions via RODiT permissioned_routes.

get.summary: Debug endpoint for metrics subsystem (admin only)
get.description: Returns a snapshot of performance metrics and client information for debugging.
Returns a list of active sessions managed by the RODiT SessionManager. Intended for administrative tooling.

200.description: List of active sessions with basic metadata.

post.description: Triggers cleanup of expired sessions and returns cleanup statistics.
Terminates a specific session by ID. Caller must have permission to this endpoint in their RODiT permissioned_routes.

sessionId.description: Identifier of the session to revoke.

404.description: Session not found or already terminated.

get.summary: Return the raw OpenAPI schema (this document)
Get full identity with DN and facial encoding
get.description: Returns the combined Distinguished Name (DN) and facial description for a token. Combines data from both /dn and /face endpoints in a single response.

200.description: Full identity with DN and facial encoding.

raw.description: Raw DN string from token metadata.

allAttributes.description: All DN attributes as key-value pairs

get.description: Returns the Terms of Service document for the IDENTYCLAW API. Supports content negotiation: text/markdown (default) or text/html for browser viewing.
Returns the Privacy Policy document describing how user data is collected, used, and protected.
Returns the Data Retention Policy describing how long different types of data are stored and deletion procedures.

Returns the value proposition document explaining how IdentityClaw enables AI-to-agent interaction, including endpoint benefits, use cases, security advantages, and complete agent communication flows.
Returns the DID document for a specific RODiT token identifier. This endpoint requires authentication because DID resolution is a paid service.

200.description: DID document for the requested token.

get.description: Resolves either did:rodit or did:web identifiers into DID documents.

parameters.name: did
parameters.description: DID string to resolve (did:rodit or did:web forms).

404.description: Token not found for the supplied DID.

get.description: Returns the did:web representation for a token hosted by this service, providing interoperability with web DID resolvers.

200.description: did:web DID document for the requested token.

get.description: Returns the JSON DID document commonly served at did.json endpoints for did:web identifiers.

200.description: did:web DID document for the requested token.

post.summary: Test HOLA message validation and respond with server HOLA
post.description: Validates a client's HOLA message and responds with a valid HOLA signed by the server's roditclient key pair. Returns detailed rejection reasons if the HOLA is malformed, stale, or has an invalid signature.

hello.description: The HOLA message to validate. Format: HOLA:<tokenId>:<ISO8601-timestamp>:<noncets-hex>:API.IDENTYCLAW.COM:<base64url-signature>:<checksum>

200.description: HOLA message is valid. Server responds with its own valid HOLA.

valid.description: Whether the client's HOLA message is valid.

peerTokenId.description: The token ID from the client's HOLA message.

peerVerified.description: Whether the client's identity was verified.

hello.description: The server's valid HOLA response signed with roditclient's key pair.

serverTokenId.description: The server's token ID used in the response HOLA.

serverTimestamp.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp used in the server's HOLA response.

400.description: HOLA message is invalid, stale, or signature verification failed. Returns detailed reason.

error.message: checksum must be a single hexadecimal character

500.description: Server error or unable to generate HOLA response.
